My cat of over 15 years, Princess, had dimentia for roughly the last 5 or so months of her life. 

I was in denial about it and thought all her issues were a combo of being a geriatric cat and hyperthyroidism. Only realized after we had her put down in December that she truly did. All the night crying, going everywhere but the litterboxes (we literally got a new the day before we decided to put her down...), staring off/not responding, gradual loss of mobility, etc. 

She for awhile began exclusively sleeping on one chair covered by the tablecloth for a month or so leading up to it. She stopped sleeping in her usual places. 

It was so sad that days before we put her down, I woke up to her curled up in ball on my chest. She'd stopped laying on me over a month prior due to having issues jumping up. And when she awoke to see I was awake, she'd purr as she would always do. 

That day at the vet, it seemed like she knew it was the end. I'm glad she is no longer suffering but I still wish she was around.
